contract_reference.selected_shape: index entries are root, child, duplicate root, and stale id; captured fields distinguish both roots and both nested children
contract_reference.scope: the fixture directly checks the unchanged pure serializer on the joined root/child/duplicate rows. The SQL join excludes stale ids before serialization. Database selection, HTTP/auth behavior, and response transport remain outside this fixture

native_boundary.source_note: production backend binds Goose externs to a libSQL native package; fixture deliberately substitutes a tiny owned resource stand-in
native_boundary.claim_limit: linkage and process isolation only; no libSQL or Promptnook database parity
